applicant.name: Dr. Lukas Steiner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

purpose: We conduct research on the distribution of type 2 diabetes across hospitals to plan a diabetes prevention programme.
question: How many adults with type 2 diabetes are registered with each hospital (data_holder)?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per hospital (data_holder): adults with type 2 diabetes.
